input.overview: Completing the C-I-R-C-U-S targets and rollovers lights the hole for its award. Marked targets, rollovers, and the left rotating target advance bonus; the hole or drain collects it. Complete the top-center rollovers to light Double Bonus. When the bonus reaches its final step, the top-left rollover lights for its award.
input.simpleOverview: Complete the C-I-R-C-U-S targets and rollovers to light the hole, then shoot the hole for its award. Use marked targets, rollovers, and the left rotating target to advance bonus. Complete the top-center rollovers to light Double Bonus. Finish the bonus ladder, then take the lit top-left rollover.
input.summary: Finish the nearest C-I-R-C-U-S letter before forcing the hole. Build bonus through the marked switches, light Double Bonus at the top-center rollovers, and take the top-left rollover only after its award lamp is on.

steps.text: Complete the C-I-R-C-U-S targets and rollovers to light the hole.
Shoot the lit hole to collect the local award and the built bonus.
Hit marked targets and rollovers, including the left rotating target, to advance bonus.
Complete the top-center rollovers to light Double Bonus; when the bonus ladder is complete, take the lit top-left rollover.

alternatives.title: Build bonus first
alternatives.when: Use this when the hole is not lit and C-I-R-C-U-S progress is scattered.

steps.text: Use marked rollovers and the rotating target to advance bonus.
Return to the missing C-I-R-C-U-S letters when a controlled shot is available.
Shoot the hole while its award lamp is lit.

machineSetup: Check whether Special awards a replay, bonus ball, or points, plus Double Bonus and bonus limits.
Test every C-I-R-C-U-S switch, hole eject, marked bonus switches, left rotating target, top-center rollovers, top-left rollover, and award lamps.
